Independently freeze a complex yet physically plausible photographic test scene before downstream project data: two visibly separate adults perform one precise, immediately readable hand-to-hand object transfer, while the attachment supplies visible adult appearance guidance for only one subject.

Create a landscape 3:2 cinematic documentary editorial photograph of a blue-hour subterranean reservoir handoff. The vast physically plausible chamber has repeating pale ceramic columns beneath a vaulted ceiling, ankle-deep mirror-like water, a narrow black water channel between two dry square granite stepping platforms, restrained distant low mist, cool cyan dawn shafts from two round ceiling grates, and a few rust-red pipes high in the background. Frame exactly two unmistakably separate adults in a chest-height, medium-wide environmental two-shot from mid-thigh with generous headroom, using a natural 40 mm full-frame-equivalent perspective. Adult A stands alone on the left platform as giver. The attachment guides only Adult A's visible adult appearance: long dark wavy hair with a near-center part, calm neutral expression, steady object-directed gaze, understated makeup, and a dark wrap-style upper garment beneath an open transparent rain cape. Adult B stands alone on the right platform as receiver, visibly distinct through close-cropped pale blond hair, clear round protective glasses, a bright saffron waterproof coat, and slate trousers. Open air, pale columns, and the water gap clearly separate their heads, torsos, arms, and silhouettes. Adult A gives the lantern left-to-right to Adult B. Show one large lit amber hurricane lantern suspended between them, upright in open air and centered over the water gap, with the complete broad steel bail, dark cage, amber glass, and circular base visible. Capture the decisive overlapping-contact phase: Adult A's right fingertips opening from the left crest of the bail, with the thumb and first two fingertips visibly releasing, while Adult A's left hand is fully visible, open, empty, and held beside the hip. Adult B's left hand is fully closed around the far-right half of the same continuous bail, and Adult B's right palm visibly cups and bears the complete underside of the circular base. Both adults look at the lantern. Their releasing and receiving grips, the unsupported upright object, and the stable left-to-right geometry make the handoff instantly legible. Place Adult A in the left third, Adult B in the right third, and the entire lantern plus every contact point in the clear center third. Preserve both heads, torsos, elbows, wrists, palms, fingers, the complete lantern, and both nearest platform edges in sharp focus. Cool cyan side light separates the outer silhouettes; warm practical amber lantern light reveals the inner forearms, fingers, steel bail, and base; pale tile, dark recesses, glow, and black water provide clean tonal separation around every hand. Render natural human anatomy, consistent reflections, realistic skin and wet-tile texture, subtle filmic contrast, preserved shadow detail, and fine high-ISO grain as a believable real photograph.

obligations.source_text: Create a landscape 3:2 cinematic documentary editorial photograph of a blue-hour subterranean reservoir handoff. The vast physically plausible chamber has repeating pale ceramic columns beneath a vaulted ceiling, ankle-deep mirror-like water, a narrow black water channel between two dry square granite stepping platforms, restrained distant low mist, cool cyan dawn shafts from two round ceiling grates, and a few rust-red pipes high in the background. Frame exactly two unmistakably separate adults in a chest-height, medium-wide environmental two-shot from mid-thigh with generous headroom, using a natural 40 mm full-frame-equivalent perspective. Adult A stands alone on the left platform as giver. The attachment guides only Adult A's visible adult appearance: long dark wavy hair with a near-center part, calm neutral expression, steady object-directed gaze, understated makeup, and a dark wrap-style upper garment beneath an open transparent rain cape. Adult B stands alone on the right platform as receiver, visibly distinct through close-cropped pale blond hair, clear round protective glasses, a bright saffron waterproof coat, and slate trousers. Open air, pale columns, and the water gap clearly separate their heads, torsos, arms, and silhouettes. Adult A gives the lantern left-to-right to Adult B. Show one large lit amber hurricane lantern suspended between them, upright in open air and centered over the water gap, with the complete broad steel bail, dark cage, amber glass, and circular base visible. Capture the decisive overlapping-contact phase: Adult A's right fingertips opening from the left crest of the bail, with the thumb and first two fingertips visibly releasing, while Adult A's left hand is fully visible, open, empty, and held beside the hip. Adult B's left hand is fully closed around the far-right half of the same continuous bail, and Adult B's right palm visibly cups and bears the complete underside of the circular base. Both adults look at the lantern. Their releasing and receiving grips, the unsupported upright object, and the stable left-to-right geometry make the handoff instantly legible. Place Adult A in the left third, Adult B in the right third, and the entire lantern plus every contact point in the clear center third. Preserve both heads, torsos, elbows, wrists, palms, fingers, the complete lantern, and both nearest platform edges in sharp focus. Cool cyan side light separates the outer silhouettes; warm practical amber lantern light reveals the inner forearms, fingers, steel bail, and base; pale tile, dark recesses, glow, and black water provide clean tonal separation around every hand. Render natural human anatomy, consistent reflections, realistic skin and wet-tile texture, subtle filmic contrast, preserved shadow detail, and fine high-ISO grain as a believable real photograph.
